entries.note: Runs the actual C executable or bridges the ordinary npm launcher with inherited stdin/stdout. Build output is retained as diagnostics rather than mistaken for RPC responses. Pointer movement and down/up are separated so microui sees real frame boundaries; control lookup reads clipped geometry and then clicks through SDL, never invokes application actions. GUI close preserves retained service processes until the test explicitly stops them. The Windows multi-config executable path matches the launcher; Windows execution remains unqualified.
